payload.core_mechanism_summary: Linearly scan for 'bear' occurrences, maintaining a start pointer; for each occurrence at pos, add (pos-start+1)*(n-pos-3) substrings where this is the first bear.
payload.rationale: The solution iteratively finds 'bear' from a moving start index, incrementally counting substrings that contain the current occurrence as the leftmost. This greedy two-pointer scan avoids double-counting without any sorting or backtracking.
